==Description==
'''Quarantine''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that only appears in [[Challenge Trials]], after [[Glass]] and before [[Fog]]. When a [[Challenge Trials|Challenge Trial]] with this modifier is beaten, it will be unlocked for the player to apply to any match.

==Effects==
When applied, tower placement footprints are increased by 10. For example, most towers will now have a footprint of 11.5; smaller towers like the [[Shotgunner]] will have a footprint of 11, while bigger ones like the [[DJ Booth]] will have 12.5.
